summary: Test-writing red phase for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI client). Added OpenAPISpecCoverageTests (gates vendoring of the published spec at iOS/OpenAPI/color-matching-openapi.json and coverage/wiring of all six /api/v1 surfaces) and OpenAPIWireConformanceTests (stubbed-response wire-format tests for manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, judgment upload; includes one deliberately red drift test asserting the spec-required normalized_linear_rgb_median). Contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (viamin/color_matching#113, not #110) are recorded in docs/openapi-generated-client-verification.md for the PR description. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test --disable-sandbox could not be executed; test logic was validated by JSON-parsing all embedded fixtures and replaying coverage assertions against a faithful reconstruction of the served document. Implementation (vendoring, swift-openapi-generator wiring, generated types, ranked-results behavioral test) is deferred to the implementation run per phase rules.
